name: Kohol (kahoola)
origin: Used across the Arab world for thousands of years to protect and beautify the eyes.
materials: Often made from brass, silver, or wood, sometimes decorated with fine carvings.
museum_role: Helps children learn how people in the past cared for their eyes and expressed beauty.
fun_fact: Kohl was kept in small bottles and applied with a thin stick called a kohl stick.
